A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BraVE research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–D support reliable comparison. The additional checklist in v3 does not create material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original CoNE experiments, online fine-tuning results, and ablation studies in Section 4 and Appendices B–D.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds action-order robustness results and normalized episode-length scores.

M1.justification: Tree construction, sparsification, traversal, losses, branch propagation, depth weighting, and beam search remain unchanged. Equations 4–5 and Algorithm 1 are retained. The new MLP and supervision descriptions clarify implementation without establishing a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same CoNE task family and environment conditions. The added ordering experiment uses the existing 8-D, 50%-pit setting and varies internal sub-action ordering without introducing new task or domain coverage.

E2.justification: FAS, IQL, and the constrained DQN comparisons are retained. Appendix B.2 additionally uses a random policy and an A* oracle as reference policies for normalized episode-length comparisons, reporting the random reference as 100 steps.

E3.justification: Section 4.2 adds a controlled experiment using five random permutations of sub-action order. Appendix B.2 introduces normalized episode length alongside return. Existing dataset generation, training budgets, evaluation frequency, and online fine-tuning schedules remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The new action-order study tests whether performance depends on a favorable tree ordering. Existing depth-penalty, TD-weight, constrained-DQN, and beam-width ablations remain unchanged; their expanded main-text summary draws on results already present in v2.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 newly identifies the uncertainty values in Tables 1–3 as standard deviations over five seeds. v2 already specifies five-seed averaging and standard-deviation shading for curves, but does not explicitly define the table uncertainties. No increase in seed counts is established.

E6.justification: Table 4 adds permutation-averaged returns of -53.5±29.1 for BraVE, -1103.6±51.4 for FAS, and -96.2±51.8 for IQL. Table 5 adds normalized scores, including BraVE's 71.4–99.3 range. Tables 1–3 and existing plotted results are retained. Section 4.1 also removes the incorrect statement that IQL trails FAS at every action-space size.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2 newly defines the normalized episode-length metric mathematically using random-policy and oracle lengths. Existing mathematical formulations and Appendix A are unchanged; no new theorem or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and central conclusion retain the same dependency-preserving, scalable BraVE proposal and up-to-20× performance claim. The additional evidence does not redefine the core contributions.

C2.justification: v3 adds a shared-network generalization rationale, interprets narrow beams as regularization, and qualifies ordering sensitivity using the new experiment. It also interprets normalized scores as near-optimal behavior. Section 6 replaces the explicit unseen-action-combination caveat with online-exploration future work, although generic dataset-quality dependence remains in the checklist.

D1.justification: Section 3.3 newly specifies a standard MLP, joint node/branch outputs in one forward pass, and a tree external to the network. The checklist adds an anonymous code-access link and describes reproduction instructions. Existing hardware, software-version disclosures, and the original GitHub link are retained.

R1.justification: The same 35 cited works and substantive related-work discussion are retained. Positioning relative to tree-based RL, factored action spaces, and other combinatorial-action methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 expands selected method explanations, rewrites the ablation summary and limitations, inserts the robustness subsection and NeurIPS checklist, and updates the conference header. The overall scientific narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Tables 4–5 are added, and existing tables, Algorithm 1, and some surrounding content are repositioned through reflow. All 13 figures retain their graphics and plotted content. The document keeps its existing visual template.

improvement.justification: The action-order experiment directly addresses a previously untested sensitivity, while clearer network descriptions and explicit table-uncertainty definitions improve assessability. These provide a limited overall gain. Validation remains confined to CoNE, the new episode-length score does not explain treatment of pit-terminated failures, and the discussion loses the specific unseen-action-combination caveat.
